# Rick Broider

> Regenerative Systems Architect, founder advisor, and Regenerative AI advocate.

Canonical site: https://rickbroider.com/

## Core Position

Rick Broider works on what comes after extractive AI. His Regenerative AI position asks how artificial intelligence can be co-parented with ancestral intelligence, human judgment, reciprocity, and living-systems thinking so that technology puts more back into people, places, and systems than it takes out.

Regenerative AI should increase human agency, capacity, continuity, creativity, resilience, and shared intelligence while reducing unnecessary extraction, dependency, fragmentation, and concentration of power.

## Four-Step Regenerative Systems Pathway

1. Regenerative Purpose
2. MVP Accelerator
3. Execution Architecture
4. Market Expansion

Rick works with visionary founders whose purpose is meaningful but whose business has outgrown the operating structure holding it.
